scenes.title: WHERE
scenes.narration: WHERE is how you filter rows, keeping only the records that satisfy a condition you define.

scenes.title: Filtering with WHERE
bullets: Tests each row against a condition
scenes.narration: WHERE evaluates a condition against every row and keeps only those that pass. It supports comparison operators like equals and greater-than, plus logical operators such as AND and OR. Because it runs early, it trims the data before any grouping or sorting takes place.

scenes.title: Filtering rows
scenes.narration: This query reads the products table and applies the WHERE condition to each row. Only products priced above one hundred survive the filter. The result lists the name and price of just those higher-priced items.

scenes.title: Where WHERE fits
steps: Continue to SELECT and ORDER BY
scenes.narration: The query first reads rows from the source table named in FROM. WHERE then tests each row and discards those that fail the condition. Only the matching rows move forward to be selected and sorted.

scenes.text: Filtering early with WHERE reduces the data your query handles, improving both clarity and performance.
scenes.narration: Applying WHERE early narrows the dataset quickly, which keeps queries both clear and fast, especially when the filtered column is indexed.
